item.description:

It has been covered and the plates have been removed. It is smashed up and broken with parts on the floor around it. It has been there since 22nd August and despite it being reported to the council, Nothing has been done. It is illegal to leave a vehicle on the public highway without number plates and attempting to hide its identy.
